Southern Company stock: Q3 gains lift 2026 outlook and demand focus
sum: Southern Company reported stronger third-quarter results on Thursday, November 5, as warmer weather, customer growth and rising commercial demand lifted earnings. The utility also pointed to a more constructive path for future growth as electricity consumption expands across the Southeast.

According to the company's earnings release, reported third-quarter net income rose to 2.0 billion US dollars from 1.7 billion US dollars a year earlier. Adjusted earnings reached 1.94 US dollars per share, up from 1.60 US dollars, while operating revenue increased 13 percent to 8.8 billion US dollars.

Management described electricity demand as broad-based, with commercial sales and data-center usage providing important momentum. The portfolio of signed large-load contracts reached 21 gigawatts, with a further 7 gigawatts in late-stage development. These commitments improve visibility for future investment, but they also increase the importance of financing, regulatory approvals and execution.

On the earnings call, executives said full-year adjusted earnings could reach 4.70 US dollars per share, above the top of the original 2026 guidance range. Management also indicated that stronger near-term performance could support higher guidance ranges for 2027 and 2028, with a broader outlook update planned for February.

The real-time quote of Southern Company stock stood at 82.87 euros on Lang & Schwarz at 11:14:58 CET on Saturday, November 7, 0.18 percent above the Xetra close of Friday, November 6. The comparison uses the latest completed Xetra session and does not measure the stock's weekly performance.

Southern Company stock gets boost as 2026 outlook rises
sum: Southern Company reported stronger third-quarter results on Thursday, November 5, 2026, as higher electricity demand, customer growth and large commercial and industrial accounts lifted earnings. The company also raised its full-year adjusted earnings outlook, giving investors a more constructive operating signal despite continuing capital demands.

Adjusted earnings reached 1.94 US dollars per share, above the 1.71 US dollars expected by Wall Street, according to Benzinga. Operating revenue rose 13 percent year over year to 8.843 billion US dollars, topping the cited 8.359 billion US dollar consensus estimate.

Total electricity sales increased 7.3 percent to 60.79 billion kilowatt-hours. Weather-adjusted commercial sales rose 7.3 percent, while the regulated utility customer base grew 0.7 percent to nearly 9 million in September.

Southern Company raised its 2026 adjusted earnings forecast to 4.70 US dollars per share from a previous range of 4.50 to 4.60 US dollars. The new outlook is above the 4.59 US dollar analyst estimate. The company kept its 2028 adjusted earnings forecast at 5.25 to 5.45 US dollars per share.

The near-term outlook is not uniformly stronger: Southern expects fourth-quarter adjusted earnings of 0.30 US dollars per share, below the 0.45 US dollar Wall Street estimate. Higher operating costs, access to capital and the scale of future generation and transmission investment remain important considerations for investors.

Southern Company stock gets earnings boost as revenue rises 13%
sum: Southern Company reported stronger third-quarter results on Thursday, November 5, 2026, with adjusted earnings benefiting from warmer weather, higher customer usage and growing demand from large commercial and industrial customers. The company disclosed the figures in a PR Newswire release.

Southern Company reported third-quarter net income of 2.046 billion US dollars, up from 1.711 billion US dollars in the same period of 2025. Reported earnings per share rose to 1.77 US dollars from 1.55 US dollars. Excluding selected items, earnings increased to 2.242 billion US dollars, or 1.94 US dollars per share, from 1.766 billion US dollars, or 1.60 US dollars per share.

Operating revenue rose to 8.843 billion US dollars from 7.823 billion US dollars, an increase of 13.0 percent. The company attributed the improvement in adjusted earnings to warmer weather, increased usage, customer growth, higher revenue from large commercial and industrial customers and stronger earnings at Southern Power.

Those gains were partly offset by higher non-fuel operating expenses, higher taxes other than income taxes and dilution from additional shares outstanding. Southern Company also recorded charges tied to wind-facility repowering, debt extinguishment and estimated losses related to Nicor Gas capital investments.

Traditional electric operating companies remained the main earnings contributor. Their net income available to common shareholders rose to 2.272 billion US dollars from 1.920 billion US dollars. Southern Power reported 52 million US dollars of net income, compared with 3 million US dollars a year earlier, while Southern Company Gas contributed 21 million US dollars, down from 25 million US dollars.

Chief Executive Chris Womack said the Southeast is growing at a pace that is "unprecedented and transformational" and that Southern Company is positioned to serve the increased demand. The release also highlights risks tied to the scale and timing of future electricity demand, new generation and transmission investment, capital access and revenue recovery.
For the first nine months of 2026, operating revenue reached 24.218 billion US dollars, up 7.3 percent from the prior-year period.

sum: Southern Company stock traded at 84.25 euros on Lang & Schwarz at 2:07 p.m. CET on Tuesday, November 3, 2026. The utility is heading into its third-quarter report, which MarketBeat said is expected before the market opens on Thursday, November 5.

Analysts cited by MarketBeat forecast earnings of 1.71 US dollars per share and revenue of 8.38 billion US dollars for the third quarter. The report is scheduled to be followed by a conference call at 1:00 p.m. Eastern Time.

Southern reported earnings of 1.13 US dollars per share in its previous quarter, above the 1.01 US dollar consensus estimate. Revenue reached 6.98 billion US dollars, below the 7.23 billion US dollar forecast cited by MarketBeat. The company said results for that quarter benefited from higher customer usage, utility investment growth, stronger equity-method earnings and lower income taxes, according to the earnings preview cited in the market coverage.

The upcoming report will therefore put both earnings growth and revenue execution in focus. MarketBeat's cited estimates imply a stronger top-line quarter than the previous report, while investors will also assess management commentary on utility investment, operating conditions and the company's outlook.

Southern has declared a quarterly dividend of 76 cents per share, payable on December 7 to shareholders of record on November 16. MarketBeat reports an annualized payout of 3.04 US dollars per share and a consensus analyst rating of Hold, with an average price target of 98.24 US dollars.

sum: Southern Company is approaching its third-quarter 2026 earnings release with investors focused on whether the utility can meet a raised comparison bar. The company is scheduled to report before the US market opens on Thursday, November 5, according to MarketBeat.

Analysts expect Southern Company to post earnings of 1.71 US dollars per share and revenue of 8.38 billion US dollars for the quarter. That would compare with earnings of 1.60 US dollars per share and revenue of 7.82 billion US dollars in the year-earlier period.

The forecast implies earnings growth of 6.9 percent and revenue growth of 7.1 percent. For investors, the release will show whether the utility's operating performance, power demand and cost management were strong enough to support those expectations.

Southern Company last reported second-quarter results on July 29. MarketBeat says the company delivered earnings of 1.13 US dollars per share, beating the 1.01 US dollar consensus estimate, while revenue reached 6.98 billion US dollars. The company has exceeded consensus earnings-per-share expectations in five of its last eight quarters, according to the same source.

The upcoming release therefore matters not only for the headline figures but also for the outlook. sum: Southern Company is scheduled to report third-quarter 2026 results before the market opens on Thursday, November 5. Analysts expect earnings of USD 1.71 per share on revenue of USD 8.38 billion, according to MarketBeat.

The forecast gives investors a reference point for the utility's next report. The earnings release is expected before trading begins, while the conference call is scheduled for 1:00 p.m. Eastern Time. Management commentary on electricity demand, generation costs and capital spending will shape the market's reading of the quarter.

MarketBeat's consensus calls for USD 1.71 in quarterly earnings per share and USD 8.38 billion in revenue. The previous-year comparison cited by the report was USD 1.60 per share and USD 7.82 billion in revenue, putting the current forecast at higher levels on both measures.

Southern Company's second-quarter performance shows why the revenue figure matters. The company earned USD 1.13 per share against a USD 1.01 consensus estimate, while revenue of USD 6.98 billion fell short of the USD 7.23 billion forecast. The mixed result leaves the November report dependent on whether stronger earnings can be accompanied by sufficient top-line growth.

Southern Company has declared a quarterly dividend of USD 0.76 per share, according to MarketBeat. The payment is scheduled for Monday, December 7, with shareholders of record on Monday, November 16. The annualized payout is USD 3.04 per share.

sum: Southern Company (ISIN US8425871071) stock was at EUR 80.69 at Lang & Schwarz on October 21, 2026, at 5:36 p.m. CEST, up 1.83 percent against the Frankfurt close of October 20, 2026. The strongest recent analyst action came from BofA on October 13, 2026, when it cut its Southern Company target from USD 100.00 to USD 92.00 and kept a Neutral rating, as MarketScreener reported.

Using the USD 90.59 primary-market price at the latest quoted time on October 21, 2026, the new USD 92.00 target stands 1.56 percent above the stock. The reduction leaves only a modest gap between the latest US price and BofA's revised objective. MarketScreener listed a 23-analyst Hold consensus and an average target of USD 96.29 in the same overview.

Southern Company is scheduled to release third-quarter 2026 results before the market opens on November 5, 2026, with a conference call at 1:00 p.m. ET. The date was announced in the company's release carried by Yahoo Finance.

For the third quarter, the consensus calls for revenue of USD 8.38 billion and earnings per share of USD 1.70, compared with USD 7.82 billion and USD 1.60 in the year-earlier quarter, according to MarketBeat. The revenue estimate implies growth of 7.16 percent, while the earnings-per-share estimate is 6.25 percent above the prior-year figure.

Southern Company had a market capitalization of USD 104.2 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 21.87 and a dividend yield of 3.00 percent in the latest market snapshot on October 21, 2026. Its US-listed utility peers traded at price-to-earnings ratios of 18.17 for Duke Energy and 22.02 for American Electric Power, with market capitalizations of USD 94.4 billion and USD 69.3 billion, respectively.

The November 5 release will put the USD 8.38 billion revenue estimate beside the USD 6.98 billion reported for the second quarter of 2026. The comparison matters because the expected earnings-per-share figure of USD 1.70 is also above the USD 1.13 reported in the second quarter, creating a clear numerical test for the utility's next update.
Southern Company stock was trading at EUR 80.69 at Lang & Schwarz on October 21, 2026, at 5:36 p.m. CEST, 1.83 percent above the Frankfurt close of October 20, 2026.
